text: What should SkyHarbor stop doing in AI experiments?
claudePromptBoundary: Full production prompt is reconstructed from current source template and captured source packet. ai_egress_audit stores prompt hash/snapshot refs, not raw prompt text by default.
claudeResponse:
4M AI/data budget envelope. Here's where to draw the kill lines specifically. Stop experimenting on capabilities with early-stage AI maturity and no data foundation underneath them.
IROPS recovery decisioning and MRO predictive maintenance are both flagged as early-stage — and both sit on top of a technology estate that includes EOL-approaching systems (Legal Oracle Engine, Slot Sabre Service) and a Weight SAP Hub with 174 integrations and a pending roadmap.
Running AI pilots on top of that substrate is burning budget to prove something you can't deploy without first resolving the dependency stack. The experiments will succeed in a sandbox and stall at integration. Stop spreading AI effort across all five business functions simultaneously.
Flight Operations, Network Planning, Airport Operations, Crew Scheduling, and Maintenance Engineering all show the same AI opportunity framing — summarization, exception triage, forecasting, guided workflow. That's a signal the portfolio hasn't been prioritized; it's been democratized. Democratized AI portfolios produce five proofs of concept and zero production deployments.
Airport turn management is the one capability tagged as mature — that's where experiments should convert to scale, not continue as experiments. Stop any experiment where the data source ownership is unvalidated. The loaded sources flag manual handoffs, fragmented reporting, and source ownership gaps across every business function.
An AI model trained on data no one owns is a governance liability, not an asset — especially in an FAA-regulated operating environment where model outputs touch safety-adjacent decisions.
The sharper kill criterion: if an experiment can't name its production owner, its data source authority, and the specific KPI it moves within 90 days, it should be paused until those three things exist. 4M envelope, and how much.
That tells you whether you're stopping experiments that are already half-spent or genuinely cutting before commitment deepens.
